data.summary: Markets & Securities Services professional with 15+ years of experience across Fund Administration, Fund Accounting, Hedge Fund Operations, Middle Office, Global Custody, and Capital Markets. Experienced in Trade Capture, Trade Processing, Trade Lifecycle, Trade Enrichment, Trade Confirmation, Trade Settlement, NAV Calculation & Validation, Cash, Position & Securities Reconciliation, Corporate Actions, SmartStream TLM Premium, Data Migration, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and operational transformation. Proven expertise in reconciliation, operational controls, stakeholder management, process improvement, migration initiatives, and client transitions across BNP Paribas, JPMorgan Chase, State Street, SS&C GlobeOp, and State Street Syntel..

experience.role: Assistant Manager – Hedge Fund Reconciliation / Fund Accounting
responsibilities: Managed end-to-end Fund Administration activities for Hedge Fund portfolios, ensuring timely and accurate NAV production.
Executed Trade Capture, Trade Processing, Trade Enrichment, Trade Confirmation, and Trade Settlement across multiple investment products.
Validated trades, Corporate Actions, income events, and investment transactions prior to NAV calculation.
Performed Cash, Position, Securities, and NAV Reconciliations while investigating reconciliation breaks and resolving exceptions within SLA.
Processed and validated SWIFT MT/MX messages supporting settlement processing and operational reconciliation.
Executed Bulk Upload of trade, settlement, and reconciliation data into operational platforms while ensuring data integrity.
Conducted STP Break Investigation and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to improve operational efficiency and reduce settlement exceptions.
Collaborated with Middle Office, Custody, Fund Accounting, and Client Service teams to resolve trade and settlement issues.
Led governance reporting, audit readiness, SLA reviews, MIS reporting, operational controls, and Business Continuity Planning (BCP)
Performed daily Fund Administration and Fund Accounting activities for Hedge Fund portfolios.
Supported the complete Trade Lifecycle from Trade Capture through Trade Settlement.
Managed Trade Confirmation activities by validating trade details and resolving confirmation exceptions.
Performed Trade Enrichment by validating settlement instructions (SSI), security master data, and trade attributes.
Processed SWIFT MT/MX payment messages supporting investment operations and settlement activities.
Performed Cash, Position, Securities, and NAV Reconciliations while investigating operational exceptions.
Coordinated with Middle Office, Custody, and Operations teams to ensure timely settlement and accurate NAV delivery.
Supported month-end NAV production, audit deliverables, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Worked extensively on SmartStream TLM Premium for reconciliation, exception management, and operational monitoring.
Supported Trade Processing, Trade Enrichment, and reconciliation activities across Hedge Fund operations.
Performed Pre-upload Validation of reconciliation files, trade data, and settlement information prior to SmartStream TLM processing.
Executed Bulk Upload of reconciliation rules, trade files, and operational data into SmartStream TLM.
Processed and validated SWIFT MT/MX messages supporting payment reconciliation and settlement validation.
Executed migration testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), reconciliation validation, and post-production verification.
Investigated STP breaks and reconciliation exceptions while performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Collaborated with technology teams during SmartStream TLM implementation, migration, and production support.
Managed end-to-end Hedge Fund reconciliations covering Cash, Position, Three-Way, FX, and Corporate Actions.
Supported Fund Administration, Trade Processing, and operational controls for Hedge Fund clients.
Coordinated offshore transition, client migration, and reconciliation platform implementation activities.
Investigated reconciliation exceptions, settlement breaks, and payment discrepancies while ensuring timely resolution.
Supported Bulk Upload of reconciliation and migration data during transition activities.
Worked closely with onshore teams during migration, UAT, and knowledge transfer.
Performed reconciliation using Geneva and Go Rec platforms for global investment portfolios.
Supported operational improvements to enhance Straight Through Processing (STP).
Supported Middle Office operations for derivatives, collateral management, and margin settlement.
Performed daily trade validation, collateral reconciliation, and settlement monitoring activities.
Coordinated with brokers, custodians, and counterparties to resolve collateral and settlement discrepancies.
Investigated MTM differences and settlement exceptions through Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Prepared daily operational MIS, KPI reports, and client reporting packs.
Supported collateral movements and exposure monitoring while ensuring adherence to operational controls.
Processed customer trade orders and supported investment-related transactions.
Conducted company research and provided investment recommendations to clients.
Assisted customers with capital market products while ensuring regulatory compliance and quality service.
